property_summary: For every input to initialize(...), the reference contract sets the stored changeFee equal to the _changeFee argument passed (changeFee == _changeFee); the mutant increments before storing (changeFee == _changeFee + 1) and thus will violate this rule for inputs where _changeFee is not already maximal and observable.
change_summary: Replace assignment to changeFee with assigning changeFee + 1 (increment by 1) so initialized changeFee is different.
